items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: I worked there about a year with them... I went right on to work with him.

ctx.x: Now, about the first real job I went on in Chicago, many people don't know it, but we were supposed to be the first band that went on the air. A fellow by the name of Hugh Swift. Oh, yeah. He had 16 pieces out of the place. They called Jeffrey Tavern. Chicago and Jeffrey.
Were you in the band when Baby played with him for Baby Dogs for a while?
